_about: ITU-T Y.3172 pipeline traceability (DOCX §4.3 / §7.4). Each stage quotes the
Y.3172 definition from the ingested Recommendation, names the project components
that perform it, and follows one quoted provision of a recorded run through it.
standard: ITU-T Recommendation Y.3172 (06/2019) Architectural framework for machine learning in future networks including IMT-2020
compliance_disclaimer: Architectural correspondence only. Formal Y.3172 compliance has not been assessed and is not claimed.

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: SRC (source): This node is the source of data that can be used as input to the ML pipeline.

project_implementation.description: Official source documents listed with provenance in the source manifest.
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: title evidence string, URL, SHA-256, retrieval date, provenance note

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: C (collector): This node is responsible for collecting data from one or more SRC nodes.

project_implementation.description: Text extraction with page provenance (PyMuPDF; python-docx for 3GPP); a file is refused if its title evidence is absent.
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: extracted character count, page numbers, refusal on wrong file

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: PP (preprocessor): This node is responsible for cleaning data

project_implementation.description: Running headers/footers removed, sections detected from printed headings or PDF bookmarks, chunked within one section.
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: section label, section heading, page, chunk ID

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: M (model): This is a machine learning model, in a form which is usable in a machine learning pipeline.

project_implementation.description: Sentence-embedding model for retrieval within each agent's own KB. No generative model: agents quote retrieved passages.
project_implementation.generator_model: none — agents quote retrieved passages; no generative model is used
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: query, cosine similarity, knowledge base searched

queries: Unusual authentication and signalling attempts are observed on the affected private 5G slice.
telecommunication entity reporting of a security incident and the time limit
types of cyber security incidents that must be reported to CERT-In
measures a telecommunication entity must take to protect telecom cyber security
unauthorised access attempts and attacks on network infrastructure

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: P (policy): This node enables the application of policies to the output of the model node.

project_implementation.description: The Verifier checks each claim against the Canonical KB (cited source/section exists, text supports the claim, in-force and amendment status) and assigns VERIFIED / INCOMPLETE / UNSUPPORTED / CONFLICT; cross-domain links and conflicts.
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: verifier outcome and rationale per claim

worked_trace.verifier_rationale: Supported by the authoritative text (Telecommunications (Telecom Cyber Security) Rules, 2024, Rule 7), but in-force status not verified and amendments not checked for this source.

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: D (distributor): This node is responsible for identifying the SINK(s) and distributing the output of the M node

project_implementation.description: The Coordinator places each verified claim in one of the five DOCX Table A1 categories; the assessment is written to the hash-chained audit trail and shown in the UI.
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: Coordinator category, audit entry sequence number and hash

y3172_definition.phrase_quoted: machine learning sandbox: An environment in which machine learning models can be trained, tested and their effects on the network evaluated.

project_implementation.description: NOT EXECUTED — not executed — the ITU AI for Good Sandbox is not available in this environment. Replay of recorded runs (src/audit/replay.py) is the local substitute for re-testing.
